definitions.explanation: The fleshy back part of the lower leg, between the knee and the ankle.

examples.english: I got a cramp in my calf.

examples.japanese: {走|はし}った{後|あと}はふくらはぎをストレッチする。
examples.english: I stretch my calves after running.

examples.japanese: {長時間|ちょうじかん}{座|すわ}っていると、ふくらはぎがむくむことがある。
examples.english: Sitting for long periods can cause swelling in the calves.

notes:
USAGE:
Always written in hiragana. The name comes from the idea of the "swelling" ({膨|ふく}らみ) of the lower leg ({脛|はぎ}). Sometimes called the "second heart" because its muscles help pump blood back to the heart.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ふくらはぎがつる (to get a calf cramp)
- ふくらはぎの{筋肉|きんにく} (calf muscles)
- ふくらはぎをもむ (to massage the calves)
